title: Vendor Posting Group INLAND controlled write gate
purpose: Create or verify exactly one Kreditorenbuchungsgruppe row for Universaarl if Page 111 and account 3300 are still visible, without touching other posting setup families.

mustConfirmBeforeWrite: Page title or visible texts confirm Kreditorenbuchungsgruppen / Vendor Posting Groups.
Field Verbindlichkeiten-Konto is visible or safely discoverable on Page 111.
No modal/dialog asks to post, preview, delete, copy company, switch company or create documents.
abortIf: The row editor cannot be scoped to Vendor Posting Groups.
INLAND already exists with a different payables account and the difference cannot be explained safely.
Account 3300 is not selectable or not visible.
Any dialog requests a broad setup import, posting, preview, delete or unrelated setup action.

entryCriteria: TARGET-029 selected Vendor Posting Groups Page 111 as the smallest safe setup write route.
TARGET-026L showed account 3300 Verbindlichkeiten aus Lieferungen und Leistungen as visible in Universaarl.
No master data or document creation has started.
acceptanceCriteria: The run stays in playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE.
Before screenshot QA captures Page 111 and the current INLAND status.
After screenshot QA shows INLAND with Verbindlichkeiten-Konto 3300, or the blocker is documented with screenshot/JSON.
No Customer Posting Groups, General Posting Setup, Inventory Posting Setup, VAT Posting Setup, master data, draft, Preview Posting, Posting or API shortcut is touched.
The result includes a next-step lookahead card for customer posting group, general posting setup, dimensions and foundation checkpoint.
